name: vclo-by-rohas
description: vCLO is a free, open-source AI legal team powered by 160+ professional legal skills, eight specialist virtual lawyers, coordinated workflows, built-in company-registry access and connector-ready business tools. Simple tasks use the relevant skill directly; complex matters produce one verified legal work product.

interface.longDescription: vCLO is a free, open-source AI legal team with one virtual Chief Legal Officer, eight specialist virtual lawyers and 160+ professional legal skills. It coordinates complex matters such as M&A due diligence, contract negotiation, litigation preparation, compliance reviews, data breach response and internal investigations. It includes free company-registry connectors and can use authorised document, email, calendar, cloud-storage, GitHub and legal-research tools available in the host environment.
defaultPrompt: Run buyer-side legal due diligence on this acquisition and consolidate the key risks.
Review this MSA for the customer, propose redlines, and prepare negotiation positions.
Prepare our litigation case strategy from these pleadings, evidence, and deadlines.
